result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but one notable visual defect stands out: the featured 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section is missing its hero image, showing a broken-image placeholder icon instead.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of the restaurant's photo, making the most prominent card on the page look broken.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or asset loading for this restaurant, and provide a branded fallback image (e.g., logo or cuisine illustration) when a photo fails to load instead of a generic broken-image icon.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card sits on a light gray placeholder with a similarly gray circular background, giving it low visual contrast compared to the same button on the pizza card below.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the favorite button uses a consistent, sufficiently contrasting overlay style (e.g., semi-transparent dark circle with white icon) regardless of the underlying image.
